claims.text:
stage computation: Two tokens A/B. Target p=[.2,.8], draft q=[.6,.4]. Draw token fromq and accept tokeni with min(1,p_i/q_i). Accepted mass=min(p,q)=[.2,.4], total.6. On rejection mass.4, sample residual normalized max(p−q,0)=[0,1]. Final token mass[.2,.8] equals target. Compute each branch probability, not a scripted token replay.

**Countercase / boundary:** Accepting all draft tokens gives[.6,.4], wrong. Reject then resample from p instead of residual gives[.28,.72], also wrong. When q=p, acceptance1 and no residual draw is used; avoid dividing by zero. Equal output distribution does not imply identical token sequences under arbitrary random seeds or a measured runtime speedup.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether accepting all proposals preserves target here; recall p=[.5,.5],q=[.8,.2] accepts total.7 and correction returns target[.5,.5].

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Accept/correct view computes branch widths with numeric masses, then Wrong correction and Matched draft show failures/boundary. Keep target, draft, accepted and corrected mass distinctly labelled; retain original target-equality witness into reveal. No remote model invocation.
